rv.q: East is East is an eruption of a show that forces us to consider it.
Happily, the second and longer half ups the ante.
Khan knows the right notes to hit to ensure it still works as well today, while also giving the production enough of its own flavour to make it worth revisiting.

cn.t: This 25th anniversary revival of Ayub Khan Din's autobiographical family drama earns praise for its engaging storytelling and emotional resonance, with critics appreciating its period setting and exploration of cultural conflict.
